# AWS Cost Audit Skill

> An executable Claude Code skill that audits a live AWS account end-to-end: it attributes every dollar, finds idle/orphaned/over-provisioned resources, checks Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and produces an evidence-backed savings plan with confidence levels and reversible, gated actions. It works on any user's own AWS account, is read-only by default, verifies all prices live, and never hardcodes a price. MIT licensed.

The skill targets Claude Code and shells out to the AWS CLI against the account in the caller's current credentials. It is governed by five non-negotiable "Iron Laws": (1) no unverified price ever, every dollar figure comes from the live, Region-specific unit price (AWS Price List Query API or the service pricing page) combined with actual usage (Cost Explorer / CUR), always shown as `unit price -> math -> source`; (2) attribute every dollar or write "unknown, could not verify"; (3) nothing destructive runs unless it is proven-unused, reversible, tested, and certain, otherwise it is a recommendation, not an action; (4) no single probe becomes a fleet-wide fact, and a separate skeptic pass re-derives every load-bearing claim from the primary source; (5) every finding carries its evidence (`current $/mo -> after $/mo -> $ saved -> confidence + evidence + reversibility`).

Who it is for: AWS account owners, FinOps practitioners, DevOps/platform engineers, and anyone whose AWS bill is too high and who wants a careful, auditable, safe-by-default cost review rather than a guess.

Two ways to install. As a Claude Code plugin: run `/plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill` then `/plugin install aws-cost-audit@aws-cost-audit-skill`. As a drop-in skill: copy the `skills/aws-cost-audit/` directory into `~/.claude/skills/aws-cost-audit/`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill/blob/main/README.md): What the skill is, who it is for, how to install and run it.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill/blob/main/skills/aws-cost-audit/SKILL.md): The skill definition: Iron Laws, workflow, the auto-execute-vs-recommend decision gate, and the highest-ROI checks.
- [Why these laws (recorded baseline)](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill/blob/main/skills/aws-cost-audit/references/why-these-laws.md): The reproducible agent-failure baseline that each Iron Law fixes.
- [LICENSE (MIT)](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill/blob/main/LICENSE): Permissive MIT license.

## Install

- [10x marketplace (recommended)](https://github.com/Aboudjem/10x): `/plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/10x` then `/plugin install aws-cost-audit@10x`. The skill is curated in the 10x marketplace alongside other Claude Code tools.
- [Plugin marketplace + install](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill#install): `/plugin marketplace add Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill` then `/plugin install aws-cost-audit@aws-cost-audit-skill`.
- [Drop-in skill](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill#install): Copy `skills/aws-cost-audit/` into `~/.claude/skills/aws-cost-audit/`.
- [Plugin manifest](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill/blob/main/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): Plugin name, version, and keywords.
- [Marketplace manifest](https://github.com/Aboudjem/aws-cost-audit-skill/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): Marketplace entry consumed by `/plugin marketplace add`.
